courses.overview: 由基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 開放式無線接取網路
related.why: 可移植「系統功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from system functional map; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「系統功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from system functional map; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步；「開放式無線接取網路」主要處理解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization; Open radio-access networks emphasizes disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「蜂巢式基地台整合」與「開放式無線接取網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「射頻鏈路」的對照方法至「管理平面」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Cellular base-station integration and Open radio-access networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from rf chain to management plane, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 時間同步 PTP 網路
related.why: 可移植「系統功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from system functional map; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「系統功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from system functional map; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步；「時間同步 PTP 網路」主要處理時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization; Precision Time Protocol networks emphasizes timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「蜂巢式基地台整合」與「時間同步 PTP 網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「射頻鏈路」的對照方法至「Ordinary clock」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Cellular base-station integration and Precision Time Protocol networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from rf chain to ordinary clocks, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

history.title: NR 架構 TS 38.300 V18.4.0
history.text: 本課的公開資料脈絡包括「NR 架構 TS 38.300 V18.4.0」與「5GS 安全 TS 33.501 V19.5.0」。課程把介面和原理改寫為自行設定的對照練習，沒有重製文章、圖像或來源算例。
